profiles.description: Mueller Water Products Inc. (MWA) is a leading provider of products and services crucial for the conveyance, distribution, and precise measurement of water throughout North America and internationally. The company's diverse portfolio serves municipal authorities, as well as the residential and commercial construction industries. Its operations are structured into two primary segments: Infrastructure and Technologies. The Infrastructure division is responsible for manufacturing and supplying a wide range of valves vital for water and gas systems, including varieties such as iron gate, butterfly, tapping, check, knife, plug, automatic control, and ball valves. This segment also produces dry-barrel and wet-barrel fire hydrants, service brass components, and pipe repair solutions like clamps and couplings designed to address leaks. Notable brands in this segment include Canada Valve, Centurion, Ez-Max, Hydro Gate, Hydro-Guard, HYMAX, HYMAX VERSA, Jones, Krausz, Milliken, Mueller, Pratt, Pratt Industrial, Repamax, Repaflex, and Singer. In contrast, the Technologies segment offers advanced solutions for residential and commercial water metering, alongside products, systems, and services for water leak detection and the assessment of pipe conditions. Key brands under the Technologies segment include Echologics, Echoshore, ePulse, Hersey, LeakFinderRT, LeakFinderST, LeakListener, LeakTuner, Mi.Echo, Mi.Data, Mi.Hydrant, Mi.Net, Mueller Systems, and Sentryx. Founded in 1857, Mueller Water Products is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
